description: This file contains TypeScript code defining types, functions, and logic for managing agents, tools, and session states in a UI application, including loading data, handling errors, and building request keys.

methods.name: loadAgents
methods.description: Loads the list of agents from the client request and updates the state accordingly, handling errors and setting default selections.

methods.name: loadToolsCatalog
methods.description: Fetches the tools catalog for a specified agent ID, updating state and handling errors.

methods.name: loadToolsEffective
methods.description: Retrieves effective tools data for a given agent and session, managing loading states and errors.

methods.name: resetToolsEffectiveState
methods.description: Resets the tools effective data and related loading/error states.

methods.name: buildToolsEffectiveRequestKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique request key based on agent ID, session key, and model override for caching purposes.

methods.name: refreshVisibleToolsEffectiveForCurrentSession
methods.description: Refreshes the effective tools data for the current session if the UI panel is active.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolsModelKey
methods.description: Determines the model key to use for effective tools, considering overrides and session defaults.

methods.name: saveAgentsConfig
methods.description: Saves the current agents configuration and reloads the agents list, maintaining the selected agent.
